download_blender_3B_model: download the Blender 3B model to a specified datapath using the download function
run_download_for_blender_3B: run the download function to fetch the BST3B.tgz model archive to the given datapath
check_blender_3B_version: check the VERSION constant to confirm the Blender 3B model version is v1.0
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it delegates to build with model_type blender_3B
summarize_blender_3B_module: summarize the blender_3B module which provides a single download function for the 2.7B parameter Blender model
